messages:
claire: Intake: customer asks for per-tenant QoS "latency|balanced|cost" plus an "adaptive budgeter" that trims or routes. Need PRD inputs: goals, non-goals, ACs, canary plan.
ben: Quick clarifying q: is trimming allowed by default or opt-in?
claire: Opt-in for now. Default is routing to variant. Trimming is an advanced action.
hiro: Ops note: long-context KV growth and burstiness are main risks. We need eviction caps and a backpressure policy.
nina: UX: single dropdown + an "advanced" checkbox. CLI: `redwood route create --qos latency`. Keep it simple.
infra-bot: FYI runtime has per-route timeouts; no per-tenant eviction cap yet.
claire: Draft ACs: 
- AC1: API accepts qos_profile on routes (latency/balanced/cost).
- AC2: "latency" p95 <=200ms in staging under sampled load for standard convo shape.
- AC3: Fallback to compatible variant <100ms added latency and logged.
- AC4: KV cache per-tenant cap prevents >40% p95 regression under burst.
- AC5: Console shows 30d cost/latency delta for tenant.
ben: Rollout: api-only alpha -> 2 customers -> 2-week canary. Rollback if p95>300ms or error rate>1.5%.
hiro: I'll own KV cap + QA harness for mixed short/long replay.
nina: I'll mock the minimal UI + CLI flows.
claire: Owners noted. I'll draft RFC tonight.
